description: With baby Eric in the house and Willie’s brother Neal entering the family orbit, ALF faces a broader set of relationships and increasingly adult questions about aging, responsibility and belonging. His life on Earth ultimately collides with the possibility of returning to his own people when Skip and Rhonda contact him from New Melmac.

s04e01.description: ALF is finally trusted to babysit baby Eric, a responsibility he has been very eager to acquire.

s04e02.description: A tabloid photographer accidentally captures ALF on film, forcing ALF and Willie into an elaborate effort to bury the evidence.

s04e03.description: ALF panics when a wanted criminal shown on television looks uncannily like Willie.

s04e04.description: ALF discovers online stock trading through Willie’s computer and quickly becomes addicted to making deals.

s04e05.description: A visit from therapist Larry inspires ALF to psychoanalyze every member of the Tanner family whether they want it or not.

s04e06.description: Willie organizes a support-group intervention when ALF develops a bizarre addiction to eating cotton.

s04e07.description: Willie’s brother Neal comes to stay, and ALF immediately begins plotting ways to shorten the visit.

s04e08.description: Neal’s extended stay leaves ALF increasingly frustrated by the restrictions required to keep his existence secret.

s04e09.description: After Lucky dies, ALF takes in a litter of kittens and finds his traditional Melmacian appetite for cats becoming harder to defend.

s04e10.description: Dorothy walks out after an argument with Whizzer, and Whizzer’s search for her finally brings him face-to-face with ALF.

s04e11.description: Following a fight with Willie, ALF moves into Neal’s apartment and rapidly threatens Neal’s home and job with his partying.

s04e12.description: When ALF catches the same cold as Willie but fails to recover normally, the family fears the illness may be lethal to a Melmacian.

s04e13.description: The Tanners host their first large party since ALF arrived, forcing him back into the attic while everyone else enjoys the house.

s04e14.description: ALF dreams that he has become a successful stand-up comedian with celebrity attention and a life built around performing.

s04e15.description: When Neal reconciles with his ex-wife, ALF becomes suspicious of her motives and tries to prove the reunion is a mistake.

s04e16.description: Praise from Lynn’s art professor convinces ALF that he may possess genuine artistic talent.

s04e17.description: After becoming an ordained Melmacian minister, ALF finds an opportunity to officiate a ceremony on Earth.

s04e18.description: ALF confronts the painful fact that his long Melmacian lifespan means he may outlive every member of the Tanner family.

s04e19.description: ALF sneaks into a retirement home and encourages an elderly woman to stop withdrawing from the people around her.

s04e20.description: An old treasure map sends ALF and Willie into Death Valley in search of buried riches.

s04e21.description: ALF attacks a polluting corporation with angry letters, only for the company to respond by offering Willie a lucrative job.

s04e22.description: A strict diet pushes ALF toward increasingly primitive instincts until he heads into the park to hunt for food.

s04e23.description: Lynn considers moving in with her boyfriend, and ALF is much more enthusiastic about the idea than the rest of the family.

s04e24.description: ALF receives word that Skip and Rhonda have founded New Melmac and prepares to leave Earth, only for the Alien Task Force to close in.
